real time reverse-transcription polymera.platform: US CDC real-time RT-qPCR primer/probe sets for 2019-nCoV_N1, 2019-nCoV_N2, and the human RNase P (RP)

evidence.quote: RNA concentrations were measured from nasopharyngeal samples by RT-qPCR as previously described 23 . For SARS-CoV-2 RNA detection, 5 μl of RNA 371 template was tested as previously described 24 , using the US CDC real-time RT-qPCR primer/probe sets for 2019-nCoV_N1, 2019-nCoV_N2, and the human RNase P (RP) as an extraction control. Virus RNA copies were quantified using a 10-fold dilution standard curve of RNA transcripts that we previously generated 24 .

evidence.quote: Briefly, freshly isolated PBMCs were plated at 1–2 × 10 6 cells / well in a 96 well U-bottom plate. Following this incubation, cells were washed and prepared for analysis on an Attune NXT (ThermoFisher).
